text: こわかったら　クチバ　から　うみぞい　まわって　セキチクへ　いくんだな！

structure.jp: クチバ　から　うみぞい　まわって
structure.en: go around along the coast from Vermilion and

structure.jp: セキチクへ　いくんだな！
structure.en: go to Fuchsia, that's what you do!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on the end of a word means 'if' or 'when'. こわかったら = 'if you're scared'.

patterns.name: 〜んだな
patterns.explanation: A plain verb with んだな tells someone what they should do, in a talking-down tone. いくんだな = 'you'd better go'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. うみぞい まわって セキチクへ いく = 'go around by the coast and on to Fuchsia'.
